clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Coverage
clauses.text: We cover the classes of personal property for which an amount of insurance is shown in the Schedule in the Declarations, for the amounts shown, against direct physical loss anywhere in the world, except as excluded in paragraph 4. Property scheduled under this endorsement is covered only by this endorsement and not under Coverage C.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Mysterious Disappearance
clauses.text: Loss includes the mysterious disappearance of scheduled property. It is not necessary for an “insured” to show that the property was stolen; it is enough that the property is missing and the circumstances of its disappearance are unexplained.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Special Limits Do Not Apply
clauses.text: The special limits of liability for loss by theft of jewelry, watches, furs and precious stones, of firearms, and of silverware and goldware in Section I - Coverage C do not apply to property scheduled under this endorsement.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Exclusions
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by wear and tear, gradual deterioration, insects or vermin, or inherent vice; by repairing, restoring or retouching, except loss by fire or explosion that results; or by war or the nuclear hazard. We do not cover loss caused intentionally by an “insured”. No other Section I - Exclusion applies to property scheduled under this endorsement.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Loss Settlement
clauses.text: We will pay the least of the following amounts: the “actual cash value” of the property at the time of loss; the amount for which the property could reasonably be repaired or replaced with property of comparable quality; or the amount of insurance shown in the Schedule for the article.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Newly Acquired Jewelry
clauses.text: We cover jewelry acquired by an “insured” during the policy period for 30 days after it is acquired, for its actual cost, up to 25% of the amount of insurance shown in the Schedule for the jewelry class or $10,000, whichever is less. You must report the property to us within 30 days of its acquisition and pay any additional premium due.

clauses.heading: Scheduled Personal Property > Deductible
clauses.text: No deductible applies to property scheduled under this endorsement.
